title: Malicious code in @openyard/vetcode (npm)
description: The npm package @openyard/vetcode versions 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 contain malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise may allow an attacker full control over the system, necessitating immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device. Simply removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
